name: Matino
terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

blurb.text: A Puglia DOC in the province of Lecce for red and rosé wine from Negroamaro, with Malvasia Nera and Sangiovese allowed up to 30% together. Its zone covers Matino and parts of nearby communes such as Gallipoli and Casarano.
